# Nifty IT surges nearly 2% after Cognizant Q3 earnings beat; Infosys, TCS, Coforge rally

## IT stocks rallied sharply on October 30 after Cognizant reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings. Coforge, Infosys, and TCS were among the top gainers as the Nifty IT index surged nearly 2%.

Coforge was the top gainer in the index, rising 4.4 per cent to the day's high of Rs 2,047.40 on the NSE. It was followed by Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Persistent Systems, HCLTech, and many others.
